CTO, Olympus Industries</span></span><h3 class="tmd-ab-h">Abilities</h3><ul class="tmd-ab"><li>Master's degree in Electrical Engineering</li><li>DAGSI graduate research fellowship with the Air Force Research Laboratory</li><li>Applied AI and digital architecture</li></ul><details class="tmd-full"><summary><span class="tmd-when-closed">Full bio +</span><span class="tmd-when-open">Close bio −</span></summary><div class="tmd-bio"><h4 class="tmd-ab-h tmd-ab-all">All abilities</h4><ul class="tmd-ab"><li>Master's degree in Electrical Engineering</li><li>DAGSI graduate research fellowship with the Air Force Research Laboratory</li><li>Applied AI and digital architecture</li><li>System architecture and hardware development</li><li>Hardware testing and validation</li><li>Motor control and ECU development</li></ul><p>Brandon Phillips is the Principal Electrical and Systems Engineer at Trifecta Engineering, and Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer at Olympus Industries, where he leads system architecture, hardware development, and technical execution. Before co-founding Olympus, he led hardware testing and validation, motor control and ECU development, and worked with customers and cross-functional teams to improve product reliability, safety, and performance across biomedical, industrial control, energy, and advanced manufacturing applications. He holds a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering and completed a DAGSI graduate research fellowship with the Air Force Research Laboratory, where his thesis work led to a publication. His technical background spans biomedical engineering, additive manufacturing, 3D-printed electronics, and electro-optical systems. He also brings applied AI and digital architecture experience, connecting hardware, software, and data into integrated systems.</p></div></details></div></li><li class="tmd-char tmd-locked" id="char-james" data-i="5" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="6 of 9: James Kaserman"><span class="tmd-pt"><span class="tmd-ph" data-photo="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="background-size:134% auto;background-position:48% 2%" aria-hidden="true"><span class="tmd-ini">JK</span></span><span class="tmd-veil" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="tmd-sil" viewBox="0 0 200 200" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M100 34c22 0 38 17 38 40s-16 44-38 44-38-21-38-44 16-40 38-40zM30 196c4-38 32-62 70-62s66 24 70 62z"/></svg><svg class="tmd-lock" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 10V7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v3"/><rect x="4.5" y="10" width="15" height="11" rx="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="15.5" r="1.6"/></svg><b>LOCKED</b><span class="tmd-vname">James Kaserman</span></span><span class="tmd-scan" aria-hidden="true"></span></span><div class="tmd-info"><span class="tmd-no">06 / 09</span><h2 class="tmd-nm">James Kaserman</h2><span class="tmd-tags"><span class="tmd-tt tmd-long">Principal Mechanical, Applied AI Engineer</span><span class="tmd-tt tmd-long">Co-Founder &amp; CPEO of Olympus Industries, brings an exceptional blend of mechanical engineering depth and applied AI expertise to Trifecta's design efforts. With experience spanning aerospace instrumentation, advanced battery systems, and intelligent automation, he has led full product design cycles, created precision test fixtures, and engineered large‑format battery solutions using thermal, structural, and flow analysis.</p><p>His work includes developing workflow automations, building internal engineering tools, and deploying production‑ready AI systems across cloud and edge environments. James has repeatedly reduced lead times, improved design efficiency, and delivered quantitative, highly reliable engineering outcomes. At Trifecta, he applies this combined mechanical and AI skillset to create end‑to‑end solutions that merge hardware precision with intelligent, deployable systems — strengthening the company's ability to innovate quickly and execute complex technical projects with confidence.</p></div></details></div></li><li class="tmd-char tmd-locked" id="char-joe" data-i="6" aria-roledescription="slide" <script>
(function () {
  /* Meet the Team D. Text is only ever set with textContent. Unlocks are cosmetic and reset on reload (no storage). */
  "use strict";
  var site = document.querySelector(".te-site.tmd");
  if (!site || site.getAttribute("data-tmd-ready")) { return; }
  site.setAttribute("data-tmd-ready", "1");
  var SAFE = /^data:image\/jpeg;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}$/;
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(site.querySelectorAll(".tmd-ph[data-photo]"), function (ph) {
    var url = ph.getAttribute("data-photo");
    if (!SAFE.test(url)) { return; }
    ph.style.backgroundImage = 'url("' + url + '")';
    ph.classList.add("tmd-is-photo");
  });
  var cards = site.querySelectorAll(".tmd-char .tmd-pt .tmd-ph");
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(site.querySelectorAll(".tmd-ph[data-photo-ref]"), function (ph) {
    var src = cards[parseInt(ph.getAttribute("data-photo-ref"), 10)];
    if (!src || !src.classList.contains("tmd-is-photo")) { return; }
    ph.style.backgroundImage = src.style.backgroundImage;
    ph.classList.add("tmd-is-photo");
  });
  var track = site.querySelector(".tmd-track"), chars = track.querySelectorAll(".tmd-char"), chips = site.querySelectorAll(".tmd-chip");
  var count = site.querySelector(".tmd-count"), toast = site.querySelector(".tmd-toast"), live = site.querySelector(".tmd-live");
  var still = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
  var total = chars.length, done = 0, current = -1, tt = null;

  var allBtn = site.querySelector(".tmd-unlock-all");
  function setCount() {
    if (count) { count.textContent = done + " / " + total; }
    if (allBtn && done >= total) { if (document.activeElement === allBtn) { track.focus(); } allBtn.hidden = true; }
  }
  function unlock(i, animate, announce) {
    var c = chars[i], chip = chips[i];
    if (!c.classList.contains("tmd-locked")) { return; }
    c.classList.remove("tmd-locked"); chip.classList.remove("tmd-locked"); chip.querySelector(".tmd-cp").classList.add("tmd-unlocked");
    done += 1; setCount();
    var pt = c.querySelector(".tmd-pt");
    pt.classList.add("tmd-unlocked"); /* the end state is set at once, so the reveal can never stop halfway */
    if (animate) {
      pt.classList.add("tmd-unlocking");
      setTimeout(function () { pt.classList.remove("tmd-unlocking"); }, 520);
      if (announce) {
        toast.textContent = "Unlocked: " + c.querySelector(".tmd-nm").textContent;
        toast.classList.add("tmd-show"); clearTimeout(tt); tt = setTimeout(function () { toast.classList.remove("tmd-show"); }, 1800);
      }
    }
    if (announce) { live.textContent = c.querySelector(".tmd-nm").textContent + " unlocked, " + done + " of " + total; }
  }
  /* leaving a card closes its Full bio (and any other non-current one); focus inside a closing bio moves to the carousel */
  function closeOtherBios(keep) {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chars, function (c, j) {
      if (j === keep) { return; }
      var d = c.querySelector("details[open]");
      if (!d) { return; }
      var hadFocus = d.contains(document.activeElement);
      d.open = false;
      c.classList.remove("tmd-bio-open");
      if (hadFocus) { track.focus(); }
    });
  }
  function focusOn(i, animate, announce) {
    if (i === current) { return; }
    closeOtherBios(i);
    current = i;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chars, function (c, j) { c.classList.toggle("tmd-is-current", j === i); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chips, function (c, j) { c.classList.toggle("tmd-is-current", j === i); if (j === i) { c.setAttribute("aria-current", "true"); } else { c.removeAttribute("aria-current"); } });
    unlock(i, animate, announce !== false);
    fitPhone();
  }
  /* phones only: the track follows the featured card's own height (desktop keeps one stable height) */
  var phoneMq = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(max-width: 760px)") : null;
  function fitPhone() {
    if (!phoneMq || !phoneMq.matches || current < 0) { track.style.height = ""; return; }
    var cs = window.getComputedStyle(track), h = chars[current].offsetHeight + parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) + parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom);
    if (isFinite(h) && h > 0) { track.style.height = Math.round(h) + "px"; }
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", fitPhone);
  /* move to a card; with a smooth scroll the unlock waits until the carousel has settled on it */
  function go(i, smooth, announce) {
    i = Math.max(0, Math.min(total - 1, i));
    var c = chars[i];
    var glide = smooth && !still && Math.abs(track.scrollLeft - (c.offsetLeft - (track.clientWidth - c.offsetWidth) / 2)) > 2;
    track.scrollTo({ left: c.offsetLeft - (track.clientWidth - c.offsetWidth) / 2, behavior: glide ? "smooth" : "auto" });
    if (!glide) { focusOn(i, !still, announce); return; }
    /* safety net: if no scroll event arrives (some browsers coalesce them), settle once the glide is surely over */
    setTimeout(function () { if (current !== i) { settled(); } }, 800);
  }
  /* reduced motion: everyone is shown unlocked at once, with no animation (so Unlock all is not needed) */
  if (still) { Array.prototype.forEach.call(chars, function (c, i) { unlock(i, false, false); }); }
  /* Unlock all: a quick cascade, 120 ms apart, each with the short scan; one announcement at the end */
  if (allBtn) {
    allBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (document.activeElement === allBtn) { track.focus(); }
      allBtn.disabled = true;
      var todo = [];
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(chars, function (c, i) { if (c.classList.contains("tmd-locked")) { todo.push(i); } });
      function finish() { live.textContent = "All " + total + " team members unlocked"; setCount(); }
      if (still || !todo.length) { todo.forEach(function (i) { unlock(i, false, false); }); finish(); return; }
      todo.forEach(function (i, k) { setTimeout(function () { unlock(i, true, false); }, k * 120); });
      setTimeout(finish, (todo.length - 1) * 120 + 560);
    });
  }
  setCount();
  /* the featured person is the card nearest the middle of the track, taken only once the carousel has settled:
     on scrollend where supported, otherwise after 140 ms without scrolling */
  var settle = 0;
  function settled() {
    clearTimeout(settle); settle = 0;
    var mid = track.scrollLeft + track.clientWidth / 2, best = 0, bd = 1e9;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chars, function (c, i) { var d = Math.abs(c.offsetLeft + c.offsetWidth / 2 - mid); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } });
    focusOn(best, !still);
  }
  track.addEventListener("scroll", function () { clearTimeout(settle); settle = setTimeout(settled, 140); }, { passive: true });
  if ("onscrollend" in window) { track.addEventListener("scrollend", settled); }
  /* Full bio open: mark the card so the top-3 list hides and the photo stays top-aligned */
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(track.querySelectorAll("details"), function (d) {
    d.addEventListener("toggle", function () { var c = d.closest(".tmd-char"); if (c) { c.classList.toggle("tmd-bio-open", d.open); } fitPhone(); });
  });
  site.querySelector(".tmd-prev").addEventListener("click", function () { go(current - 1, true); });
  site.querySelector(".tmd-next").addEventListener("click", function () { go(current + 1, true); });
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(chips, function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { go(parseInt(b.getAttribute("data-go"), 10), true); }); });
  track.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); go(current + 1, true); }
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); go(current - 1, true); }
  });
  /* keyboard users reaching a locked card's controls unlock it too */
  track.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) { var c = e.target.closest(".tmd-char"); if (c) { focusOn(parseInt(c.getAttribute("data-i"), 10), !still); } });
  go(0, false, false); /* first card: no announcement on load */
})();
</script>
